question: In melanoma trials using ICI plus BRAFi+MEKi, list the BRAF and MEK inhibitors used in the regimen.
ground_truth_column: braf_inhibitor -> Control regimen | mek_inhibitor -> Control regimen
augmented_sql:
SELECT "NCT", "PubMed ID", "Treatment regimen", "Control regimen" FROM clinical_trials
WHERE "Cancer type" = 'Melanoma' AND "Type of combination" = 'ICI+BRAFi+MEKi';
